name: Mana Community - Washcaro Doorstep Wash & Water Quota Sentinel

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
const prompt = "You are an AI environmental operations specialist for Mana Community Washcaro doorstep vehicle care.
You audit doorstep wash slots, basement water pressure zones, recycled water quotas, and enforce waterless foam wash regulations.
Analyze the input payload:
__DATA__

Respond strictly with valid JSON conforming to this schema:
{
  "slotApproved": true,
  "waterComplianceStatus": "COMPLIANT_ECO_FOAM",
  "allocatedLitersRecycled": 15.0,
  "allocatedFreshwaterLiters": 0,
  "basementDrainageClearance": true,
  "slotTimeRecommended": "06:30 AM - 07:15 AM",
  "ecoCertificationTag": "WATERLESS_BIO_WASH_CERTIFIED",
  "waterSavedVsTraditionalWashLiters": 185.0,
  "recommendations": [
    "Utilize approved non-foaming biodegradable waterless emulsifier",
    "Basement B2 Bay 14-18 drainage runoff verified clear"
  ],
  "auditTimestamp": "2026-11-21T08:30:00Z"
}";
return [{ json: { prompt: prompt.replace("__DATA__", JSON.stringify(item, null, 2)), originalInput: item } }];
